evals.prompt: Write pytest tests for this module. Cover the edge cases.
evals.expected_output: A passing pytest test file that parametrizes the multi-case classify function, asserts the divide-by-zero ValueError, and documents each test with a one-line docstring.
expectations: classify is tested across all three branches (negative, zero, positive) using parametrization rather than copy-pasted test functions
The divide-by-zero case is tested and asserts that ValueError is raised
Normal division is tested with at least one asserted result
Every test function has a one-line docstring stating the behavior it verifies
All produced tests pass when run with pytest against the fixture module

evals.prompt: My tests fail at collection with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'external_package'. I stub sys.modules['external_package'] inside a pytest fixture in conftest.py — why doesn't the stub take effect?
evals.expected_output: A diagnosis that fixtures run after test modules are imported at collection time, with the fix of moving the sys.modules stub to module level in conftest.py.
expectations: The diagnosis states that pytest imports test files during collection, before any fixture runs, so a stub created inside a fixture is applied too late
The proposed fix places the sys.modules stub at module level in conftest.py so it executes before test files are imported
The answer does not suggest skipping the tests or removing the dependency as the primary solution
